tools.name: get_eurocollis_info
tools.description: What EuroCollis is, the corridors it operates, currency, deposit model and where bookings are completed.

tools.name: get_services
tools.description: Shippable item catalogue with pricing units — use item_id values when calling get_quote with items.

tools.name: get_prohibited_items
tools.description: Items EuroCollis and Morocco/EU customs prohibit. Always surface before a booking recommendation.

tools.name: get_routes
tools.description: Every supported Morocco ↔ Europe corridor. Optionally scope to one corridor for live trip volume.

tools.name: get_cities
tools.description: Supported pickup/delivery cities for one country. Use these exact names as origin_city / destination_city in get_quote.

tools.name: get_quote
tools.description: Authoritative price quote for a Morocco ↔ Europe shipment, returned from the same pricing engine the website uses. Provide weight_kg for boxes/suitcases or items[] for catalogue goods. Never re-compute prices yourself.

tools.name: search_couriers
tools.description: Live, verified couriers with upcoming trips on a corridor. Demo accounts, unverified couriers and past departures are excluded.

tools.name: get_courier
tools.description: Public profile for one courier by storefront slug or courier id. No PII.

tools.name: get_storefront
tools.description: Published courier storefront with its canonical URL (custom domain / subdomain / platform path) and corridor pages. Omit slug to list storefronts.

tools.name: track_shipment
tools.description: Public shipment status. Requires BOTH the reference and the delivery city (anti-enumeration). No PII returned.

tools.name: estimate_customs
tools.description: Indicative duty + VAT estimate. NOT authoritative — always render the returned disclaimer verbatim.

tools.name: convert_currency
tools.description: Convert an amount between EuroCollis-supported currencies using live MAD-based rates.
